body:
Every Plan story gets a size, **S, M or L**, with a one-line reason. The size then guides how much planning the story gets.

## What I want
- A size per story (S / M / L) and a short reason based on the story's complexity: how many parts it touches, risk, unknowns, and whether it touches other code that has to be retired or migrated.
- **Start from Research's `S-01` sizing** (mode and size of the whole request). Story sizes refine it per story; they don't duplicate it.
- The size is visible in the plan set and the final review, next to each story.
- The size guides depth: an S story needs few tasks and short acceptance criteria; an L story gets full depth.

## Not in this story
- The fast track itself (fewer stages for small work). That is #1218, which builds on these sizes.

## Context
Replaces the sizing half of #957 (Research from 2026-10-19 on the old team version: a sizing step per story, run right before its story step).
title: Plan: size every story (S/M/L)
